title: AlphaDog Styles Unisex Tank Top for Adults - Dog Breed Geometric Art, Front Emblem and Full Body Back Print
desc:
Wear your best friend. Bold geometric faceted illustration of your dog's breed on a soft unisex jersey tank: a small emblem portrait on the front and the full body drawing across the back.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Style: pick your breed.
2. Color: pick the color.
3. Size: pick your size.

FABRIC AND FIT: Bella+Canvas 3480 unisex jersey tank, about 4.2 oz, 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton (heathers include polyester). Soft, light and breathable retail fit.

DETAILS
- Printed in the USA, made to order just for you.
- Finished with the AlphaDog Styles logo label.
- Production 2-5 business days, then 3-7 business days in transit within the US. Tracking included.

CARE
Machine wash cold, inside out, with similar colors. Tumble dry low. Do not iron or dry clean the print.
bullets: ORIGINAL DOG ART: geometric art of your dog's breed by AlphaDog Styles - pick your breed in the Style menu
DESIGN: Geometric Art with a small emblem portrait on the front and the full body drawing across the back
FABRIC AND FIT: Bella+Canvas 3480 unisex jersey tank, about 4.2 oz, 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton (heathers include polyester). Soft, light and breathable retail fit
MADE TO ORDER IN THE USA: printed just for you, tracking included. Production 2-5 business days, then 3-7 business days in transit
PERFECT GIFT for dog moms, dog dads and every dog lover. Finished with the AlphaDog Styles logo label
